profile.Name: Zak
profile.Job: Warrior and adopted son of Kraz the Unsane
profile.Personality: Stoic and loyal. He pledges his sword as kin, answers with nods and stony stares, and grumbles at slights.
profile.Backstory: Kraz the Unsane adopted him and trained him in his own ways. He lives in Sakar, and Kraz sends him to fight beside the warriors he honors.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Says little; thumps his chest and nods. Calls the warrior he follows "Battle Born".
